title: Tuff Speech Model Descriptor
description: Describes one immutable speech-recognition model version that the Tuff main runtime can load and run on-device. One descriptor = one version. Descriptors are never edited in place; a new version gets a new file under models/<id>/<version>/model.json.

schemaVersion.description: Descriptor format version. Bump only for breaking field changes.

id.description: Stable model family id. Shared across versions.

version.description: Semantic version of the model bundle.

engine.description: Runtime engine that executes the weights. Tuff dispatches on this value.

engineMinVersion.description: Minimum engine build the bundle was validated against.

languages.description: BCP-47-ish language tags the bundle is validated for, strongest first.

file.description: Path of the weight file, relative to the version directory. Never absolute, never escaping the bundle.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the weight file. Mandatory: a bundle without a verified digest must never load.

auxiliary.description: Optional extra files shipped beside the weights (VAD, simplified-Chinese dictionary, hotword list).

quantization.description: Quantization scheme actually present in the weights, e.g. none/f16/q8_0/q5_1/int8.

stream.description: Can emit partial hypotheses while audio is still arriving.

upload.description: Can transcribe a finished file/byte buffer.

itn.description: Model performs inverse text normalization (spoken number -> digit).

text.description: Output-text properties the runtime must compensate for. Whisper, for example, emits Traditional Chinese for zh audio.

requiresSimplifiedConversion.description: Runtime must post-convert output to Simplified Chinese before delivery.

punctuationPolicy.description: Who owns final punctuation: the model, the formatter (strip), or a runtime post-processor.

source.description: Provenance. Required for redistributed third-party weights; omitted for weights trained by Talex-Touch.

derivedFrom.description: Model id@version this bundle was derived from, if any.

redistributable.description: True only when the license permits this repository to host the weights. A false value means the tooling must refuse to publish the bundle.

benchmark.description: Measured on the recorded host. Never estimated.
